title: Timesketch：假說、反證與可追溯故事
titleEn: Timesketch: hypotheses, counterevidence and traceable narratives
subcategoryTitle: 證據保全、復原與韌性演練
subcategoryTitleEn: Evidence preservation, recovery and resilience exercises
summary: 每個故事主張連到事件ID與來源，將支持、矛盾與未知證據分欄，避免只收集支持說法的事件。
summaryEn: Link each narrative claim to event IDs and sources, separating supporting, contradictory and unknown evidence to avoid confirmation bias.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

steps.objective: 完成「故事與證據契約」的執行本階段研究，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete carry out this investigation for Narrative-evidence contract and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
Timesketch 將時間線、註解與故事連結；本課只匯入自編假資料並手動分析。 每個故事主張連到事件ID與來源，將支持、矛盾與未知證據分欄，避免只收集支持說法的事件。
逐項完成本階段動作，在結果表保留輸入、公式或狀態轉移、輸出及版本。將每個輸出對到以下判準，不能以「已做完」代替工程證據：每個故事主張連到事件ID與來源，將支持、矛盾與未知證據分欄，避免只收集支持說法的事件。
steps.instructionEn:
Timesketch links timelines, annotations and narratives; import only original fake data and analyze manually. Link each narrative claim to event IDs and sources, separating supporting, contradictory and unknown evidence to avoid confirmation bias.
Carry out each action and retain inputs, formulas or state transitions, outputs, and revision. Map every output to the following criterion; completing an activity is not acceptance evidence: Link each narrative claim to event IDs and sources, separating supporting, contradictory and unknown evidence to avoid confirmation bias.
steps.observation: 原始紀錄支持本階段的結果，而非只有結論。每個故事主張連到事件ID與來源，將支持、矛盾與未知證據分欄，避免只收集支持說法的事件。
steps.observationEn: Raw records support the investigation outcome, not only a verdict. Link each narrative claim to event IDs and sources, separating supporting, contradictory and unknown evidence to avoid confirmation bias.
steps.failure: 省略中間資料，使驗收判據無法逐項重現。
steps.failureEn: Omitting intermediate records so that acceptance cannot be reproduced criterion by criterion.
steps.check: 每個故事主張連到事件ID與來源，將支持、矛盾與未知證據分欄，避免只收集支持說法的事件。
steps.checkEn: Link each narrative claim to event IDs and sources, separating supporting, contradictory and unknown evidence to avoid confirmation bias.

quiz.question: 「故事與證據契約」：若要檢查結果是否可信，哪一項提供本課的獨立驗證動作？
quiz.questionEn: Narrative-evidence contract: Which statement provides an independent verification action for judging whether the result is credible?
options: 從每個結論反向點回原事件，檢查不同時間線是否其實複製同一來源；保存搜尋條件。
自動摘要可能把推測寫成事實；本課不用外部AI傳送日誌，所有結論由合成證據支持。
以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 合成故事有18個主張，12個有獨立佐證，3個被證據反駁，3個仍未知。
optionsEn: Trace each conclusion back to original events, check whether timelines copy the same source, and retain search queries.
Automated summaries can turn hypotheses into facts; this course sends no logs to external AI and grounds conclusions in synthetic evidence.

This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. A synthetic narrative has eighteen claims: twelve independently supported, three contradicted and three unresolved.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「獨立驗證方法」。從每個結論反向點回原事件，檢查不同時間線是否其實複製同一來源；保存搜尋條件。 與本階段判準一起判讀：每個故事主張連到事件ID與來源，將支持、矛盾與未知證據分欄，避免只收集支持說法的事件。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies independent verification. Trace each conclusion back to original events, check whether timelines copy the same source, and retain search queries. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Link each narrative claim to event IDs and sources, separating supporting, contradictory and unknown evidence to avoid confirmation bias.

把名義組與變更組並列，逐欄確認只改了預定條件；若需多變量，另開實驗編號。用同一單位檢查趨勢、偏差與判準：每個故事主張連到事件ID與來源，將支持、矛盾與未知證據分欄，避免只收集支持說法的事件。

Return to the investigation: Timesketch links timelines, annotations and narratives; import only original fake data and analyze manually. Link each narrative claim to event IDs and sources, separating supporting, contradictory and unknown evidence to avoid confirmation bias.
Compare nominal and changed runs column by column, confirming that only intended conditions changed. Give multi-variable experiments separate IDs. Check trend, bias, and criterion in common units: Link each narrative claim to event IDs and sources, separating supporting, contradictory and unknown evidence to avoid confirmation bias.
steps.observation: 對照組與變更組的差異能追到明確輸入或量測機制。從每個結論反向點回原事件，檢查不同時間線是否其實複製同一來源；保存搜尋條件。
steps.observationEn: Differences between control and changed runs trace to explicit inputs or measurement mechanisms. Trace each conclusion back to original events, check whether timelines copy the same source, and retain search queries.
steps.failure: 同時變更多個輸入卻把結果歸因於單一因素。
steps.failureEn: Changing multiple inputs and attributing the output difference to a single factor.

steps.title: 故事與證據契約 · 分辨異常成因
steps.titleEn: Narrative-evidence contract · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「故事與證據契約」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Narrative-evidence contract and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
自動摘要可能把推測寫成事實；本課不用外部AI傳送日誌，所有結論由合成證據支持。
對照「故事與證據契約」的名義結果，分別建立系統故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。保留替代假說與反證，修訂故事時標記版本；不能刪除不合敘事的事件。
本階段必須重驗：每個故事主張連到事件ID與來源，將支持、矛盾與未知證據分欄，避免只收集支持說法的事件。
steps.instructionEn:
Automated summaries can turn hypotheses into facts; this course sends no logs to external AI and grounds conclusions in synthetic evidence.
Against the nominal Narrative-evidence contract result, build competing system-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Retain alternative hypotheses and counterevidence, version narrative revisions, and never delete inconvenient events.
Reverify this criterion: Link each narrative claim to event IDs and sources, separating supporting, contradictory and unknown evidence to avoid confirmation bias.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。自動摘要可能把推測寫成事實；本課不用外部AI傳送日誌，所有結論由合成證據支持。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Automated summaries can turn hypotheses into facts; this course sends no logs to external AI and grounds conclusions in synthetic evidence.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.

steps.checkEn: Link each narrative claim to event IDs and sources, separating supporting, contradictory and unknown evidence to avoid confirmation bias.

steps.objective: 完成「故事與證據契約」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Narrative-evidence contract and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付18項主張證據表、可重跑搜尋、來源去重理由與修訂後故事。
在交接件中加入「故事與證據契約」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：每個故事主張連到事件ID與來源，將支持、矛盾與未知證據分欄，避免只收集支持說法的事件。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：每個故事主張連到事件ID與來源，將支持、矛盾與未知證據分欄，避免只收集支持說法的事件。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver eighteen claim-evidence rows, repeatable searches, source-deduplication rationale and a revised narrative.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Narrative-evidence contract: Link each narrative claim to event IDs and sources, separating supporting, contradictory and unknown evidence to avoid confirmation bias.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Link each narrative claim to event IDs and sources, separating supporting, contradictory and unknown evidence to avoid confirmation bias. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。每個故事主張連到事件ID與來源，將支持、矛盾與未知證據分欄，避免只收集支持說法的事件。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Link each narrative claim to event IDs and sources, separating supporting, contradictory and unknown evidence to avoid confirmation bias.

steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
